about: Observed CPUID (EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX per leaf.subleaf) and RDMSR (EDX:EAX or #GP) of the bootstrap processor per profile; the a64 profiles' ID registers (tests/a64/id_registers.c) are expected from tests/platform/a64-profile.json; generated by tools/cpu_contract.mjs, checked by `node tools/cpu_contract.mjs --check`
